title: Pilaf Stuffed Quinoa Bites
description: A crunchy, nutty, and quinoa-packed snack that's easy to make and fun to eat. Perfect for a quick pick-me-up or as a side dish for a party.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pilaf, quinoa, crunchy, and nutty. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and add salt and black pepper to taste. Mix well.
Add the egg mixture to the pilaf mixture and mix until well combined.
Use a spoon or your hands to shape the mixture into small balls.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Optional: For an extra crunchy coating, roll the balls in chopped nuts or seeds before baking.
